typography: Platform system sans with compact game-context marker, large shared statement, and plain-language truth labels.
palette: Dark low-glare stage with lime action signal; semantic text-plus-shape states never rely on color alone.
composition: One shared card, one persistent beacon, role instruction, two large answer actions, and a separate post-answer review; Private Relay replaces the card with a shutter at handoff.
density: Sparse active-round hierarchy that preserves attribution, role, next action, and game context under divided attention.
geometry: Generous rounded panels, visible spacing, and a 56 dp MVP touch-control minimum.
imagery: No social-post chrome, public-figure imagery, screenshots, or profile mimicry; content is a fixture statement until editorial approval exists.
signature: Persistent room beacon that makes the prompt unmistakably a game before reveal.
motion: Minimal orientation-only transitions; tap-only and reduced-motion routes keep equivalent game semantics.
